messages:
rafa: Heads-up: I'm consolidating release-note fragments for the 2.1.1 patch. We got a couple tiny doc fixes and one mention of a broken internal link on the "Getting Started" guide.

ina: I fixed the internal link in a small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/427. It replaces `/docs/getting-started#quickstart` with `/docs/getting-started#setup`.

rafa: Nice. Can we call out that misc link fixes and small snippet updates are included in the patch notes? Keep it one short sentence.

sam: Also confirm whether the changelog should mention the table-of-contents reflow fix for mobile. It's low impact but was customer-reported.

rafa: Agreed to include: "minor docs link fixes and mobile TOC reflow" as a bullet.

docs-bot: Release notes draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/430

ina: One more tiny thing: the Python SDK example uses named arg `kms_key` but the SDK expects `kmsKey` now. I added a line to the migration guide to highlight that.

rafa: Add a quick "API surface change" note to the migration blurb. We only need to say "case of param names changed in SDK v2.1" and link to migration guide.

sam: OK. I'll approve after PR summary updated.

docs-bot: PR updated with reviewer comments.

rafa: Thanks all. Merging in 10 if there are no more comments."
